events.name: San Jose Sharks at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — Colin Graf scored a short-handed goal and Alex Nedeljkovic stopped 38 shots on Thursday night to help the San Jose Sharks win 4-2 and hand the Bruins their first loss in Boston since Christmas.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sharks beat Bruins 4-2, snapping Boston’s 13-game home winning streak

headlines.description: — Jakob Chychrun scored with 1:33 left to play, Charlie Lindgren made 29 saves, and the Washington Capitals beat Buffalo 2-1 on Thursday night to snap the Sabres' eight-game win streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chychrun scores third period goal to give Capitals 2-1 win over Sabres

events.name: Anaheim Ducks at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — William Nylander broke a tie on a power play 36 seconds into the third period and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Anaheim Ducks 6-4 on Thursday night to end an eight-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maple Leafs beat Ducks 6-4 to end 8-game slide. Matthews injured on knee-on-knee hit

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Jake Guentzel and Gage Goncalves each scored twice, Andrei Vasilevskiy made 23 saves and the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the Detroit Red Wings 4-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guentzel, Goncalves each score twice in the Lightning's 4-1 win over the Red Wings

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Sam Reinhart scored 2:20 into overtime to lift the Florida Panthers over the Columbus Blue Jackets 2-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reinhart scores in OT as Panthers down Blue Jackets 2-1

events.name: Calgary Flames at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — John Beecher scored his first two goals for Calgary, and Mikael Backlund recorded his 600th career NHL point with a third-period goal in the Flames’ 5-4 win over the New Jersey Devils on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beecher scores twice, Backlund reaches 600-point mark in 5-4 Flames win over Devils

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Carolina Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Jimmy Snuggerud scored twice to lead the St. Louis Blues to a 3-1 win over the Eastern Conference-leading Carolina Hurricanes on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Snuggerud scores 2, Binnington stops 31 shots as Blues beat East-leading Hurricanes 3-1

headlines.description: — Jason Robertson had two goals and two assists to tie a career high in points and Jamie Benn also scored twice as the surging Dallas Stars beat the Edmonton Oilers 7-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robertson, Benn have two goals each in surging Stars' 7-2 win over Oilers

headlines.description: — Travis Konecny scored the lone goal in a shootout to give the Philadelphia Flyers a 3-2 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Konecny scores lone shootout goal to lift the Flyers past the Wild, 3-2

events.name: New York Rangers at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — Alexis Lafreniere had a goal and an assist to lead the New York Rangers to a 6-3 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lafreniere's goal and assist help Rangers beat the Jets 6-3

headlines.description: — Connor Bedard scored off a rebound off a post at 3:57 of overtime to give the Chicago Blackhawks a 3-2 victory over the Utah Mammoth on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor Bedard scores in OT to lift the Blackhawks past the Mammoth, 3-2

headlines.description: — The Vancouver Canucks scored a pair of third-period goals to erase a two-goal deficit then got a shootout goal from Jake DeBrusk to beat the Nashville Predators 4-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: DeBrusk scores only goal of shootout to lift Canucks over Predators 4-3

events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Pavel Dorofeyev had two goals and an assist and the Vegas Golden Knights beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 6-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dorofeyev scores twice, Golden Knights snap 3-game slide with 6-2 win over Penguins

headlines.description: — Nazem Kadri scored his first goal since rejoining Colorado and Nathan MacKinnon added his NHL-leading 44th score of the season as the Avalanche beat the Seattle Kraken 5-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kadri scores 1st goal since rejoining Avs, MacKinnon adds his NHL-best 44th in 5-1 win over Kraken
